messages:
Maria V: Quick heads-up 1 I opened a docs PR to clarify Optimize toolkit behavior when batching + cache interact with quantized model fallbacks. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4973 :wave:

Alex J: pinged. do we want example snippets in both py + js? keep the examples tiny. :ok_hand:

Maria V: yes both. current PR accidentally uses the deprecated client.optimize call and 'cache_scope=global' which people misinterpret as cross-tenant caching. need: (1) helper quickstart showing withFallback(), (2) explicit profile example for advanced teams, (3) note about including model_variant in cache key, and (4) circuit-breaker recommendation for CPU fallbacks.

Devon R: paste the old snippet so we can see it in-thread.

Maria V: here's the old one that caused confusion:

```python
# old (deprecated)
client.optimize(model=\"rwkv-8q\", batching=True, cache_scope=\"global\")
```

Maria V: People read \"global\" as global across routes/tenants. Danger. Also no mention of fallback ordering.

Alex J: propose two replacements. Short helper (JS) and full profile (py) examples. Helper first:

```js
// helper quickstart
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new RedwoodClient()

await client.optimize.withFallback({
  model: 'rwkv-8q',
  cacheKey: (ctx) => `${ctx.routeId}:${ctx.modelVariant}:${ctx.promptHash}`,
  fallback: ['rwkv-8q','rwkv-16q','rwkv-fp16']
})
```

Alex J: note in copy: cacheKey must be route-scoped to avoid cross-tenant leaks and include modelVariant so hits are correct.

Lena QA: nit: show that cacheKey returns a string. add small sentence about latency: \"When fallback escalates to CPU FP16, latency may spike  consider circuit-breaker settings.\" Also remind folks that withFallback returns a best-effort response and may surface a fallback_reason field.

Maria V: good. now the explicit profile example to show full control (py):

```python
# explicit optimize profile (advanced)
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient()
profile = \"\"\"
model: rwkv-8q
cache_key_components: [route_id, model_variant, prompt_hash]
fallback_order: [rwkv-8q, rwkv-16q, rwkv-fp16]
batching:
  max_tokens: 256
  latency_slo_ms: 120
\"\"\"

c.optimize.apply_profile(profile)
```

Devon R: add a short example of how to run the local snippet test harness so engineers can validate behavior end-to-end (helps reviewers):

```bash
# run the snippet harness locally
make docs-snippet-test SNIPPET=optimize-quant-fallback
```

Samir (docs): I'll take PR #4973 and do wording + link fixes. Plan:
- replace deprecated snippet with helper + profile
- rephrase section to avoid the word \"global\" and explicitly call out \"route-scoped\" cache keys
- add the circuit-breaker note and link to Optimize -> fallbacks guide
- add the test harness command to the PR as a follow-up commit
- fix two dead links in the migration guide

Alex J: I can review the wording this afternoon. small suggestion: link the SDK helper API reference next to the JS snippet rather than inline with the code block.

Maria V: thanks! also can we add a 1-line table in the migration guide that maps deprecated patterns -> recommended replacements? keeps the changelog tidy.

Samir (docs): yes will add a compact mapping. merging plan: once Alex approves wording and CI passes (docs lint + snippet tests), I'll merge. Docs-bot: PR #4973 status: open  requested review from @Samir (docs), @Alex J. CI: lint OK :white_check_mark:, snippet-tests pending.

Maria V: thanks team 1 ::thumbsup:

Lena QA: leaving a reminder to QA: run the snippet harness with a quantized-fail simulation to verify the fallback_reason is surfaced and circuit-breaker trips as expected.

Devon R: added to my list. will try to run the harness later today.

Samir (docs): merging after Alex review and snippet-tests. Appreciate the quick turnaround everyone :tada:
